name: Golden cross (50/200 MA crossover)
hypothesis: The 50-day moving average crossing above the 200-day signals a durable uptrend worth owning.
signal_rule: Hold the S&P 500 while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average; move to cash when it drops below.
plain_rule: When the 50-day line crosses above the 200-day line, you buy. When it crosses back under, you sell.
exit: 50-day MA crosses below 200-day MA (the death cross)
claimed_result: The most-quoted buy signal in retail trading- claimed to catch every bull market and dodge every crash
paper_ref: Brock, Lakonishok & LeBaron (1992), Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns, Journal of Finance
